comment: Canonical list of legendary-arena.com subdomains. Read by scripts/check-subdomains.mjs. When adding or changing an entry, also update DOMAINS.md (one section per anchor). Field reference: see DOMAINS.md §Adding a new subdomain.

domains.name: Apex (legendary-arena.com)
domains.notes: Apex redirects to www via a zone-level Cloudflare Redirect Rule on the legendary-arena.com zone (Rules -> Redirect Rules), NOT via Pages _redirects (CF Pages does not support full-URL source patterns in _redirects). Direction is locked: apex -> www. Live since 2026-05-09 (WP-006 lock).

domains.name: Marketing (www)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-05-09 (WP-006 lock). CF Pages project: legendary-arena-website.

domains.name: Game client (play)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-05-10 (WP-007a lock). CF Pages project: legendary-arena-play. Cross-origin brand-tokens contract verified against https://www.legendary-arena.com/brand-tokens.css; bundled local fallback at /brand-tokens.local.css verified byte-identical to live URL (SHA-256 70C11CEB...). Server CORS allowlist updated under EC-147 to include https://play.legendary-arena.com and https://legendary-arena-play.pages.dev.

domains.name: Registry viewer (cards)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-07-08. CF Pages project: legendary-arena (custom domain cards.legendary-arena.com attached alongside the legendary-arena.pages.dev placeholder). The registry-viewer SPA authenticates cross-origin against api.legendary-arena.com; server CORS allowlist includes this hostname (WP-146).

domains.name: Public player wiki
domains.source: TBD - separate Hugo site (not yet authored)

domains.name: Engineering wiki (private, gated)
domains.source: apps/wiki-viewer (Hugo build of docs/wiki/); Worker legendary-arena-wiki
domains.notes: Live since 2026-05-08; served by the assets-only Cloudflare Worker legendary-arena-wiki since the D-24690 cutover (workers_dev and preview_urls off, so the custom domain is the only hostname). Cloudflare Access redirects unauthenticated probes to login (302) or rejects them (401/403). A 200 here means the gate is misconfigured and the private wiki is publicly readable. expectedLocation is a prefix; the Access login URL appends a long JWT in the query string that varies per request.

domains.name: Engineering wiki (retired Render origin, must 404)
domains.source: none — Render static site legendary-arena-wiki, retired by D-24690
domains.notes: The retired Render service's built-in onrender.com host. It served the full wiki UNGATED (observed 200 on 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-11) because the ewiki Access application gates only ewiki.legendary-arena.com. D-24690 moved the ewiki to a Cloudflare Worker; once the Render service is deleted, Render answers 404 for this host. state is 'planned' until then: a 200 reports FAIL (service still exists — delete it); a 404 reports READY — flip state to 'live'. Any later 200 is a security incident (DOMAINS.md#ewiki).

domains.name: Legends scoreboard (public attract board)
domains.notes: Live since 2026-07-08. CF Pages project: legendary-arena-legends. Public, no-auth. Reads leaderboard JSON snapshots from R2 (written by WP-142 publisher) via images.legendary-arena.com; the deployed bundle contains zero api.legendary-arena.com / *.onrender.com references (zero-API by design). A 200 here proves the SPA shell loads; snapshot freshness is a separate concern verified by the publisher's own health check (GET /health/legends-publisher). NOTE at cutover: the WP-142 publisher was still idle (LEGENDS_PUBLISHER_ENABLED unset), so panels render the no-data state until it is enabled — a data-supply concern, not a board defect.

domains.name: Internal admin dashboard
domains.notes: Live since 2026-06-02. Served by the assets-only Cloudflare Worker legendary-arena-dashboard since the D-24690 cutover (workers_dev and preview_urls off); before that, the CF Pages project legendary-arena-dashboard. Cloudflare Access (Self-hosted, Email OTP, single-operator allow = jeff@barefootbetters.com) redirects unauthenticated probes to login (302) or rejects them (401/403). A 200 here means the gate is misconfigured and the dashboard is publicly readable. expectedLocation is a prefix; the Access login URL appends a long JWT in the query string that varies per request. Launched in mock mode (D-19702); now a live-mode build (VITE_USE_MOCKS=false, VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://api.legendary-arena.com, Hanko sign-in; read from the deployed bundle 2026-10-10), so a missing gate exposes the live operator dashboard with only the server's admin-session check in front of live data.

domains.name: Internal admin dashboard (retired pages.dev alias)
domains.source: none — CF Pages project legendary-arena-dashboard, retired by D-24690
domains.notes: The retired CF Pages project's built-in production alias. It served the live operator dashboard UNGATED from 2026-06-02 (observed 200 on 2026-09-10, 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-11): the dashboard Access application gates only the custom domain, and Pages' Enable access policy covers only preview deployments. D-24690 moved the dashboard to a Cloudflare Worker with no default hostname. Until the Pages project is deleted this row reports FAIL (200). Once it is deleted the hostname stops resolving (PENDING) and this row is removed. Any 200 here is a security incident (DOMAINS.md#dashboard).

domains.name: API (game server, friendly hostname)
domains.notes: CNAME api.legendary-arena.com -> legendary-arena-server.onrender.com (DNS only, not Cloudflare-proxied — Render needs direct origin access for Let's Encrypt cert renewal and websocket transport). Live since 2026-05-09. Both this hostname and the canonical onrender.com hostname stay healthy in parallel during the dual-running window. PUBLIC_BASE_URL is unrelated to this hostname — it is the CLIENT URL Stripe Checkout redirects users to after success/cancel (see apps/server/src/billing/billing.routes.ts) and is updated when play.legendary-arena.com is deployed, not now.

domains.name: Card images CDN
domains.notes: Canonical host since 2026-07-16; legacy images.barefootbetters.com is a second custom domain on the same bucket and remains live (no redirect). Bucket index commonly returns 403 or 404; specific keys return 200. Probe verifies DNS/TLS reachability, not bucket contents.
